response.sql: WITH matched_spatial AS (SELECT p.fundflux FROM scanspatial sp INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry), source_counts AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM matched_spatial GROUP BY fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_count, AVG(record_count) as avg_count FROM source_counts) SELECT sc.fundflux, sc.record_count as count, CAST(sc.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count as share, sc.record_count - t.avg_count as above_average FROM source_counts sc CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE sc.record_count > t.avg_count ORDER BY sc.record_count DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "Coverage" is measured by count of spatial survey records per funding source, not by summed area or volume

alternatives.interpretation: "Coverage" refers to total surface area (sum of aream2), so count is the combined area per funding source
alternatives.sql: WITH matched_spatial AS (SELECT p.fundflux, sp.aream2 FROM scanspatial sp INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry), source_areas AS (SELECT fundflux, SUM(aream2) as total_area FROM matched_spatial WHERE aream2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(total_area) as total_coverage, AVG(total_area) as avg_coverage FROM source_areas) SELECT sa.fundflux, sa.total_area as count, CAST(sa.total_area AS REAL) / t.total_coverage as share, sa.total_area - t.avg_coverage as above_average FROM source_areas sa CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE sa.total_area > t.avg_coverage ORDER BY sa.total_area DESC;
